metadata.title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
metadata.coverage: EGA I front matter and introduction, all of EGA 0_I, the Chapter I programme and sections 1–9, and section 10 through Lemma 10.8.2 with proof, environment 10.8.3, Definition 10.8.4, and the attached restriction, topological inverse-limit and additive covariant completion-functor paragraphs immediately before Proposition 10.8.5
metadata.completion_limit: This cumulative checkpoint does not claim that the full EGA corpus is complete.
